---
name: release-summary
description: Summarize merged pull requests and unresolved release blockers. Use when preparing release notes or reviewing release readiness.
---

# Release summary

Read the release milestone and the merged pull requests assigned to it. Group the
changes by their effect on users, and link each item to its pull request. Describe
configuration changes with an example of the previous and current behavior.

List unresolved blockers with their owners and the evidence needed to close them.
Keep speculative work out of the release notes. When a pull request has no user
impact, record it in the internal engineering summary instead.

Return draft notes and the blocker list for review before publishing a release.
